text:
maya: Heads up — I deployed a RBAC scoping change at 02:05 UTC and we started seeing mTLS handshake failures in apac for service-proxy -> inference-router. Error rate ~12% and rising.

sam: logs?

maya: pasting a few snippets from the proxy pod logs and cloudtrail: 
```
[2026-03-22T02:06:11Z] proxy=service-proxy-12 handshake failed: tls: handshake error: remote error: tls: BAD_RECORD_MAC
[2026-03-22T02:06:12Z] proxy=service-proxy-12 auth: KMS Decrypt error: AccessDeniedException: User arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/proxy-role/session cannot call kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789012:key/xxxx (Service: AWSKMS; Status Code: 400; Error Code: AccessDeniedException)
```

liam: That sounds like the new namespace/rolebinding removed the kms:Decrypt permission for the assumed role used by the proxy in apac. Did we scope out cross-account principals in the recent PR?

harper: PR #4821 tightened kms policies and removed a few broad principals. tagging the PR owner @maya — can you confirm what was changed?

maya: yep — I scoped the proxy role policy to only platform-managed services to reduce blast radius. Looks like we accidentally excluded the regional proxy SA. We have three options: revert the PR, re-add kms:Decrypt for the proxy-role in apac only, or route to fallback model variants while we remediate.

sam: Revert is quickest for recovery. If we want minimal change, hotfix the rolebinding to re-allow kms:Decrypt for the proxy SA.

liam: Agreed. Hotfix + audit trail is best. Also collect CloudTrail events so we can calculate exposure window and which principals attempted decrypts: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z`

maya: I'll apply a regional hotfix now. Command I plan to run (will post when complete):
```
kubectl -n infra patch rolebinding proxy-kms-binding -p '{"subjects":[{"kind":"ServiceAccount","name":"proxy","namespace":"infra"}]}'
# then push minimal IAM/KMS change back for ap-southeast-1 principal: update-policy ...
```

ops-bot: deploy started for hotfix/rolebinding-624000 (kube-apply triggered).

harper: Also, let's create a short alert rule for KMS AccessDenied spikes so we get early paging next time: threshold 5/min -> #eng-security. Can someone add it?

liam: After hotfix, we'll run a canary (10% traffic) to apac-inference for 15 minutes and measure p50/p95 and error rate. If error rate >1% rollback.

maya: Hotfix applied at 02:12 UTC. KMS CloudWatch metric for DecryptDenied dropped to baseline within 2 minutes. Starting canary.

sam: Canary metrics look good — p95 latency restored and handshake errors back to baseline.

harper: I'll own the postmortem writeup: timeline, root cause (RBAC scoping omitted regional SA), remediation (hotfix + CI KMS lint), and follow-ups.

liam: Follow-ups: add a small PR gate test that assumes the role and attempts a `kms:Decrypt` on a test key; add per-region role sanity check job in infra-ci. Also add a note to the runbook for immediate rollback steps.

maya: Thanks — sorry about the noise. Learned to double-check regional bindings when scoping cross-account principals.

security-bot: Incident record created: INC-624000 (brief). Playbook entry added: playbooks/mtls-kms-rbac-failures.md

maya: Closing this thread after postmortem lands. :thumbsup:
